item.title: Washburn upsets Central Missouri, captures first MIAA Championship in over a decade
item.description: KANSAS CITY, Mo. (KSNT) - The Washburn Ichabods are MIAA Champions. Washburn women's basketball upset top-seeded Central Missouri on Sunday, 53-44, to win the MIAA Tournament Championship. It's Washburn's first tournament championship since the 2011-12 season. item.description: KANSAS CITY, Mo. (KSNT) - It wasn't even close. Washburn men's basketball claimed its first MIAA Championship since 2021, dominating Rogers State in the final 91-58.
